columns.name: TaskID
columns.description: Unique task id, e.g. T000001 (organizer sample uses T001).

columns.name: Date
columns.description: Date the task was performed.

columns.name: Vertical
columns.description: Industry vertical.

columns.name: SiteID
columns.description: Job site / mine id.

columns.name: MachineID
columns.description: Machine used for the task.

columns.name: OperatorID
columns.description: Operator who performed the task.

columns.name: TaskType
columns.description: Task type; allowed values depend on Vertical.

columns.name: MachineType
columns.description: Machine type; allowed values depend on Vertical.

columns.name: MachineAge_yrs
columns.description: Machine age.

columns.name: MaterialType
columns.description: Material handled; allowed values depend on Vertical.

columns.name: TerrainSlope_deg
columns.description: Average terrain slope at the work area.

columns.name: Weather
columns.description: Weather label derived from the conditions (Rainy > Dusty > Windy > Cloudy > Sunny).

columns.name: Temperature_C
columns.description: Mean air temperature over the task window.

columns.name: WindSpeed_kmh
columns.description: Wind speed.

columns.name: Humidity_pct
columns.description: Mean relative humidity over the task window (v1.1).

columns.name: Visibility_m
columns.description: Worst visibility over the task window: fog, dust, heavy rain (v1.1).

columns.name: Precip_mm_h
columns.description: Mean rain rate over the task window (v1.1).

columns.name: OperatorSkill
columns.description: Operator skill level.

columns.name: OperatorExpHours
columns.description: Operator's total operating experience.

columns.name: LoadVolume_m3
columns.description: Material volume moved/processed.

columns.name: HaulDistance_m
columns.description: One-way haul distance; 0 for non-haul tasks.

columns.name: TimeOfDay
columns.description: Shift period in which the task started.

columns.name: StartHour
columns.description: Local start hour; TimeOfDay is derived from it (v1.1).

columns.name: EstimatedTime_min
columns.description: Naive planner estimate from task_standards (scaled by volume/distance). The model must beat it.

columns.name: ActualTime_min
columns.description: Target: actual task duration (up to 2 days in extreme heat, v1.1).

generation_rules.weather: Sampled per task from the site's climate profile (catalog.SITE_CLIMATE) for its month and start hour; no stored history.
generation_rules.ActualTime_min: EstimatedTime_min x skill x age x slope x night x wet_ground x visibility x beginner_bad_conditions / heat_work_fraction x noise
generation_rules.heat_work_fraction: ml/features/conditions.py: shade WBGT from temp + humidity -> 100/75/50/25% work at WBGT <=28/29/30/>30 °C; AC cab (machine < 8 yrs) keeps 70% of the time lost
generation_rules.visibility: ml/features/conditions.py: travel slows below 1000 m, haulage waits below 200 m (haul tasks 70% driving, others 20%)
generation_rules.wet_ground: ml/features/conditions.py: up to +35% by material wet-sensitivity (clay worst, rock least) + 15% safety pause above 7.6 mm/h
generation_rules.beginner_bad_conditions: x1.10 if OperatorSkill=Beginner AND (rain >= 0.5 mm/h OR visibility < 1000 m OR wind >= 30 km/h)
